import argparse,json
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--status',required=True)
parser.add_argument('--minimum',required=True,type=float)
a=parser.parse_args()
with open('orders.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: orders=json.load(f)
print(json.dumps([r for r in orders if r['status']==a.status and r['total']>=a.minimum],separators=(',',':')))
